correctness.rationale: The graph and the extendible-face definition are correct. A separate edge-subset search produced 36 perfect matchings and the stated f-vector, totaling 30,504 faces including the empty face. With the literal frozen toggle order, a separate Hasse traversal processed all 30,503 nonempty faces and all 163,650 incidences, finding 15,238 disjoint pairs and critical counts (1,0,3,23). Signed integral column eliminations in Hasse topological order produced the complete matching 3-by-23 boundary; the minor gcds are (1,1,2). Forman's CW model has two-skeleton a wedge of three S² and no higher-than-three cells. Integral degrees determine the attaching maps by Hurewicz. View the attachment as the homotopy cofiber of a map from a wedge of 23 S² to a wedge of three S²: unimodular row/column operations are realized by self-homotopy equivalences of these wedges. Smith entries 1,1 cancel, 2 yields M(Z/2,2), and the 20 zero columns give 20 S³. Modular evidence alone would not establish this result. The frozen checkers were inspected, not executed.
